# Global Claude Rules

## No Claude attribution

Never add Claude / Claude Code attribution to anything. This includes:
- The `Co-Authored-By: Claude` trailer in commit messages.
- The "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]" line (or any variant) in pull request bodies, issue bodies, comments, or descriptions.
- Any "generated by / made with Claude" note in code, docs, or any other output.

Keep commits, PRs, and all output clean of Claude attribution.
# graphify
- **graphify** (`~/.claude/skills/graphify/SKILL.md`) - any input to knowledge graph. Trigger: `/graphify`
When the user types `/graphify`, invoke the Skill tool with `skill: "graphify"` before doing anything else.
